people.role: Deputy steward of the outer gate; keeps the Frost Test roll
people.appearance: Her breath smokes even in the warm hall; she carries the roll under one arm like a child.
people.backstory: Ice answered her at dawn of her third and last sitting, so she keeps the roll of every name that sits the mere and walks the line at midnight with qi-warmed stones for the sitters; Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) pretends not to see them.

ties.note: her superior and her oldest friend at the lake
teacher of the primer at the outer gate; the seat's man at the lake
has failed the Frost Test twice
oldest of the outer gate; failed three Frost Tests and stayed

tree.intent: Ice wards that hold others still.

people.role: Teacher of the primer at the outer gate; the seat's man at the lake
people.appearance: That voice, trained to carry across lake wind.
people.backstory: Khương Lưu Ly's (khuong_luu_ly) man at the lake, he teaches the primer to the outer gate and tells them that the seat, not the frost coast, is the Pavilion. He has the sitters' wrapped stones taken at the water's edge; Phù Sương Nguyên (phu_suong_nguyen) fainted on the ice and lay there until the count was done.

ties.note: they share the lake and disagree about it
the coast's loudest voice in the inner gate
outer disciple with a faint Ice the lake has not yet woken

people.role: Skiff disciple who carries the Hall of Cold Law's letters along the frost coast
people.appearance: Burn-spotted lamp-maker's fingers; a whistle every harbour knows.
people.backstory: Tuyết Đăng Trấn's lamp-maker's son, he carries Thẩm Hàn Giang's (tham_han_giang) letters between the coast towns in Lục Hàn Chu's (luc_han_chu) skiffs. He charges the drowned divers' widows a copper to hand over their men's last letters, and the skiff-men have stopped sitting beside him.

ties.note: his patron; Mạnh carries his word
they share a skiff in bad winters

people.role: Tax-reckoner of the Hall of Cold Law on the frost coast
people.appearance: Abacus beads click in her sleeve; she squints at anything not set in columns.
people.backstory: A fish-buyer's daughter from Triều Bình Thôn who counts the frost coast's tax for Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang); her sums and the treasurer Quách Lẫm's (quach_lam) have never once agreed, and she suspects his.

ties.note: the seat's counts against the coast's
the clerk who sits across from her
copyist of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang
skiff hand of the frost coast

people.role: Ice-hole fisher and skiffman on the frost coast
people.appearance: His grandfather's wool cap; a three-fingered ice-fisher's mitten on the left hand.
people.backstory: He fishes through the ice off Lư Ngư Thôn the way his grandfather did before the Pavilion came, and wants no part of the succession; Mẫn Băng Hà (man_bang_ha) keeps trying to give him one.

people.role: Thẩm Hàn Giang's disciple at the seat; the frost coast's voice among the inner disciples
people.appearance: Salt-streaked braids, and a shout held back behind her teeth.
people.backstory: A sail-watcher's daughter from Vọng Phàm Thôn who says at the seat what Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang) cannot say himself; the seat calls it shouting, and she has twice been one breath from striking Kỷ Hàn Bách (ky_han_bach).

ties.note: frost-coast boy in the outer gate

people.role: Keeper of the Desert Pavilion's caravan ledgers
people.appearance: Ledger powder has greened her fingertips; she weighs every coin on her palm before she takes it.
people.backstory: Born to the fish-pond traders of Ngư Đàm Thôn, she keeps Ôn Sa Ngọc's (on_sa_ngoc) caravan books and knows to the stone what the seat costs the desert; she does not say it at the seat.

ties.note: carries her letters home to the oasis

people.role: Caravan rider of the Desert Pavilion's guard
people.appearance: His gaze always rests on the horizon; the lips are sun-split.
people.backstory: From the salt pans of Chử Diêm Thôn, he rides point on the caravan road for Tôn Hàn Thạch (ton_han_thach) and has crossed it a hundred and nine times; he has been to the seat twice and did not like the silence.

ties.note: brought her to the Desert Pavilion on his saddle

people.role: Keeps the founder's cold well at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Well-rope calluses on both hands; scribe's sleeves pinned neat.
people.backstory: A Hồi Lan scribe's daughter who believes the founder's cold well is the Pavilion's true heart; she draws its water each dawn beside Cát Ngọc Trì (cat_ngoc_tri) and would rather stay in the desert than be called up to the ice.

people.role: Desert-born guard of the Desert Pavilion who passed the Frost Test on his third sitting
people.appearance: Upper tooth missing; stands bow-legged as a camel-driver.
people.backstory: A camel-driver's son from Đà Linh Trấn who felt Ice only at the dawn of his last sitting, he went back to the desert by choice and trains the caravan guards' sons for Tôn Hàn Thạch (ton_han_thach).

ties.note: caravan guard in training under Úc Hoàng Sa

people.role: Cuts the standing graves in the burial glacier
people.appearance: Chisel tucked behind his ear; grit in every knuckle crease.
people.backstory: Raised by the burial keepers, he has cut every grave in the burial glacier for sixty years, standing and facing south, for Nhạc Băng Thiềm (nhac_bang_thiem), and keeps one niche cut and empty for himself.

ties.note: his son in the outer gate

people.role: Watcher of the Ice Soul vein; the warden's niece
people.appearance: Tilts her head to the west when thunder is near.
people.backstory: Kha Tĩnh Ba's (kha_tinh_ba) brother's daughter, raised in the vein watch since she left Kê Minh Trấn, she counts the lightning strikes on Băng Phách Mạch each night and has lately had more of them to count.

ties.note: keeps the lightning rods on the Ice Soul vein

people.role: Plum Sword Hall swordsman of Tưởng Hàn Phong's side
people.appearance: Turns his clan's seal ring when he is slighted; boots too fine for the hall.
people.backstory: A clan's heir, he took Tưởng Hàn Phong's (tuong_han_phong) side when Phó Ám Hương (pho_am_huong) chose Hạ Lăng Hàn, and has not crossed swords with her in practice since, which in the Plum Sword Hall is louder than a quarrel.

people.role: Array Hall disciple who checks the lid stones of the Jade Vessel Array
people.appearance: Damp knees; the smell of lamp oil from the tunnels.
people.backstory: He walks the array's lid stones under the seat every tenth day for Tiết Hàn Mai (tiet_han_mai) and writes down what he finds; this year he has written 'warm' four times, and Tiết has read each of those pages twice.

people.role: Desert-born rider of the Beast Hall
people.appearance: Sable's tail stitched to her cap.
people.backstory: Hồ Tiểu Đàm's (ho_tieu_dam) cousin from the same fish ponds, she passed the Frost Test on her first sitting, rides ice sables for Lam Tuyết Điêu (lam_tuyet_dieu), and writes to Hồ before every solstice. She hoards the Beast Hall's good hay in a loft she rents to a Hồi Lan furrier and feeds Lam's old white mare the dust; the mare went lame at the thaw.

people.role: Frost-coast boy in the outer gate
people.appearance: Speaks in the coast's sing-song; a fishing-line scar round one wrist.
people.backstory: From Lãnh Ngạn Thôn, where the coast still sings Hàn Giang's songs, he came to the lake because Tống Ngư Lan (tong_ngu_lan) told the village a coast child could rise.

people.role: Tiêu-clan daughter; sits her first Frost Test at the coming solstice
people.appearance: Powders her long plain face white; the clan's gloves are too small for her hands.
people.backstory: Tiêu Bạch Lộ's (tieu_bach_lo) elder sister, sent after him when the clan of Hòe Âm decided that one Tiêu at the Pavilion was a gamble and two were a policy; she sits the lake at the coming solstice.

people.role: Has failed the Frost Test twice
people.appearance: Snow melting in his hair most mornings; goes blank mid-sentence, as if his voice had been blown out.
people.backstory: A raft-village boy who has failed the lake twice and practises sitting in a snowdrift every night; Nhiếp Lăng Tuyết (nhiep_lang_tuyet) brings him in before he freezes and says nothing to Đỗ Sương Nhi.

ties.note: brings him in from the snow
they failed the same two solstices

people.role: Sits her third and last Frost Test at the coming solstice
people.appearance: Crosses her fingers behind her back; trips on dry ground; net-mender's calluses.
people.backstory: Her mother failed three Frost Tests and went home to Ngân Ngư Thôn to mend nets; she sits her third at the coming solstice and has told Uông Tuyết Nhạn (uong_tuyet_nhan) she will not follow her to Lãnh Giang.

people.role: Seal-hunter's boy, new in the outer gate
people.appearance: Wide, sleepy grin.
people.backstory: Phan Đông Nhi's (phan_dong_nhi) neighbour from Hải Báo Thôn, he followed her to the lake and spends more time watching the Beast Hall's sables than breathing the primer. He sleeps in the hay through his feeding turns, and Phan has taken the strap for his empty buckets.

people.role: Outer disciple with a faint Ice the lake has not yet woken
people.appearance: Fine pale hair that stands up when she is afraid.
people.backstory: From Băng Khổng Thôn like her teacher Kỷ Hàn Bách (ky_han_bach), she was tested with a thread of Ice in her root and is more afraid of the lake than anyone who has none.

people.role: Hầu Ngư's younger brother
people.appearance: Sits on a fishing hole as if it were a stool, heels drumming.
people.backstory: Hầu Ngư's (hau_ngu) little brother, who keeps open the fishing holes his brother cuts in the lake by sitting on them; between them they feed half the outer gate in winter.

people.role: The tea master's grandniece in the outer gate
people.appearance: Careful step with every cup.
people.backstory: Ông Tĩnh Hải (ong_tinh_hai) sent for his brother's granddaughter when her root was tested; she carries his qi-warmed tea down to the lake on Frost Test night, the one thing he has ever asked of the Pavilion.

ties.note: tea servant who warms the seat's water with qi

people.role: Đàm Tĩnh Thạch's niece; wants the Array Hall
people.appearance: Chalk-white fingers from drawing patterns in the snow.
people.backstory: Đàm Tĩnh Thạch's (dam_tinh_thach) sister's daughter from the waterfall village, she draws the Array Hall's patterns in the snow and sits the lake for the first time at the coming solstice.

ties.note: shares her sleeping mat at the lake

people.role: Oldest of the outer gate; failed three Frost Tests and stayed
people.appearance: One shoulder worn down by other people's bags; stops mid-word, blank, until someone says his name.
people.backstory: He failed his third Frost Test at twenty-six, refused the Desert Pavilion and the road, and stayed at the lake as the outer gate's unpaid elder brother; Trương Lãnh Hà (truong_lanh_ha) is the only one who calls it pride.

people.role: The grave-cutter's son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Grave-cutter's squint.
people.backstory: Điền Hàn Tạc's (dien_han_tac) son, raised in Hàn Trạch Thôn by his mother's people, he came to the lake knowing exactly where he will be buried and is in no hurry to pass.

ties.note: his father's friend, who checks on him

people.role: Skiff hand of the frost coast
people.appearance: Palms blistered at the bow oar; the eyes go pale grey when she judges ice.
people.backstory: Mẫn Băng Hà's (man_bang_ha) bow-oar since she passed the Frost Test, a harbour orphan who reads ice from a skiff by its colour. When a floe split she rowed home without Lăng Hàn Sinh (lang_han_sinh) and said he had jumped; a net-boat fished him out days later, half drowned.

people.role: Outer disciple lent to the coast; dives for ice-pearls
people.appearance: Hair that never dries; a pearl-seller's smile.
people.backstory: From the skin-boat village of Bì Thuyền Thôn, he dives for ice-pearls with Lăng Hàn Sinh (lang_han_sinh). He palms the best pearl of every dive into his cheek and swears the deep took it, and Lăng has been docked a season's share for the losses.

people.role: Copyist of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang
people.appearance: Covers the page with her sleeve as she writes.
people.backstory: A Mộc Lan Thành scholar's daughter who copies the frost coast's tax rolls for Phạm Lãnh Vân (pham_lanh_van), sending one copy to the seat and one to Lạc Ngạn Băng (lac_ngan_bang). She trims the line that names Thẩm's second set from the seat's copy, and when the sums disagree Lạc takes the blame.

ties.note: the seat's clerk, whose copies never match

people.role: Frost-coast inner disciple sent down from the seat after a quarrel
people.appearance: Knuckles still swollen from the fist that cost him the seat.
people.backstory: He answered Trịnh Lăng's (trinh_lang) joke about coast accents with his fist, the one thing the Pavilion does not forgive, and Lưu Hàn Ngạn (luu_han_ngan) took him to Liên Giang before the hearing could sit.

people.role: Mạnh Triều Sương's nephew; a skiff boy
people.appearance: Forearms like bailing buckets.
people.backstory: Mạnh Triều Sương's (manh_trieu_suong) nephew, who cleared the gate on his Water and spends his outer-gate years bailing his uncle's skiff, badly; last month he fell asleep on the bucket, and the catch Thái Hàn Ngư (thai_han_ngu) had trusted him with spoiled.

people.role: Salt-boiler's daughter at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Salt-white lashes; a laugh that comes out as a cough.
people.backstory: Mục Sa Hành's (muc_sa_hanh) cousin from the salt pans, she reached the Desert Pavilion on his saddle and means to sit the lake, though she has never seen ice outside a cup.

ties.note: took her in at the Desert Pavilion

people.role: Oasis boy who failed the Frost Test three times
people.appearance: Rolls a coin across his knuckles, mouth twisted bitter.
people.backstory: An inn-keeper's son, he failed his third Frost Test last winter and was sent back to Ôn Sa Ngọc (on_sa_ngoc) at the Desert Pavilion; he says the lake answers only ice-born children, and has started saying it in Hồi Lan's taverns.

people.role: Hồi Lan girl who passed the Frost Test; Giang Sương Lạc's disciple
people.appearance: Heavy harbour anklets that she refuses to take off.
people.backstory: The second Hồi Lan harbour child in a generation to pass the lake, she chose to come back to the Desert Pavilion under Giang Sương Lạc (giang_suong_lac) rather than be the seat's curiosity.

people.role: Cát Ngọc Trì's niece at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Reed cuts on both hands; she cannot hold a laugh in.
people.backstory: Cát Ngọc Trì's (cat_ngoc_tri) brother's youngest, she helps her aunt draw the founder's cold well and grows oasis reeds in its overflow, as Hồ Tiểu Đàm (ho_tieu_dam) taught her.

people.role: Caravan guard in training under Úc Hoàng Sa
people.appearance: Camel dust in his eyebrows.
people.backstory: A camel-town boy whose Water only just cleared the gate, he trains with the caravan guard under Úc Hoàng Sa (uc_hoang_sa) and has no intention of ever sitting on a frozen lake.

people.role: Stable servant at the Desert Pavilion; Mã Đông Lâm's sister
people.appearance: Straw in her braid; a horse's patient stare.
people.backstory: Mã Đông Lâm's (ma_dong_lam) sister, raised half-wild beside him, with no Water at all, who came anyway to keep the Desert Pavilion's horses; the horse village still sends one child a century, and she says she does not count.
people.exception: R2: servant (tạp dịch) of the Desert Pavilion's stables; no Water, breathes an Earth stand-in by Ôn Sa Ngọc's leave

people.role: Furnace boy of the guest alchemist's hall at Hàn Giao Chử
people.appearance: Eyebrows singed off once and never regrown; he cannot stand still.
people.backstory: Named for the one thing the Pavilion forbids, he tends the furnace at Hàn Giao Chử, outside the array where flame is allowed, and Dương Lô (duong_lo) has taught him enough Fire breathing to keep it lit.
people.exception: R2: servant (tạp dịch) of the guest alchemist's hall outside the array; Fire root, taught a stand-in breath by Dương Lô

people.role: Washer of the seat's undyed robes; Đào Hàn Mặc's mother
people.appearance: Hands bleached white, wrinkled to the wrist.
people.backstory: She washes four hundred undyed robes in water warmed by other people's qi; Âu Dương Tuyết (au_duong_tuyet) let her and her son Đào Hàn Mặc (dao_han_mac) sit in on the primer; it never took for either, but she found a Wood breath of her own in the washing steam.
people.exception: R2: servant (tạp dịch) of the seat, servant-born; Water below the gate, breathes a stand-in by the quartermaster's leave

people.role: Tea servant who warms the seat's water with qi
people.appearance: Palms always warm, steaming faintly in winter air.
people.backstory: Sent up from Ngân Ngư Thôn at ten to carry water, he turned out to warm it in his hands; Ông Tĩnh Hải (ong_tinh_hai) uses him to heat the tea and has asked Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) to test him at the spring intake.

ties.note: his master in the tea room

people.exception: R2: servant (tạp dịch) who came as a child before his root was tested; up for the spring intake

people.role: Tạ Ngân Sương's disciple
people.appearance: Perfectly still face; one tiny line between the brows she is proud of.
people.backstory: A teacher's daughter, she passed the Frost Test two winters ago and has taken the Ice Heart more literally than her teacher Tạ Ngân Sương (ta_ngan_suong) would like: when her friend Chu Sương Linh (chu_suong_linh) wept at the lake she turned her back and has not spoken to her since.

people.role: Plum Sword Hall disciple; grinds the red ink
people.appearance: Red-stained cuffs; the hunched back of a grinder.
people.backstory: An ink-grinder's son and Thân Ngưng Lam's (than_ngung_lam) only disciple, he grinds the red ink she copies with and has learned more of the Lãnh Hương forms from the margins than from the practice floor.

people.role: Beast Hall rider
people.appearance: Owl feathers tucked behind one ear; unblinking pale eyes.
people.backstory: Raised by snow-owl trappers on the tundra above Hàn Trạch Thôn, he rides behind Ninh Bạch Hồ (ninh_bach_ho) on patrol and talks more to the sables than to people.

people.role: Keeps the lightning rods on the Ice Soul vein
people.appearance: Hair that stands on end near the rods; sets each foot down as if testing it.
people.backstory: A Kê Minh Trấn boy like his warden, he keeps the lightning rods on Băng Phách Mạch for Quan Lăng Ba (quan_lang_ba) and has twice been knocked flat by the vein, which is why he walks so carefully.

people.role: Array Hall junior
people.appearance: Dark circles under the eyes; the lamp never trembles in her hand.
people.backstory: A geomancer's daughter, she holds the cold-light lamp for Văn Tuyết Khanh (van_tuyet_khanh) in the tunnels under the seat, and is the one who notices when Đàm Tĩnh Thạch (dam_tinh_thach) comes up with damp sleeves.
